messages.subject: Feedback on oSCR cheat sheet
parts:
Hello everyone! I was wondering if I could ask you a favor. I designed a cheet sheet for oSCR (see attachment) and before I release it into the wild aka Twitter and RStudio Cheet Sheet Repository, I was wondering if you could take a look and provide feedback or comments on it. After all, you have used oSCR and are familiar with the program. Andy, Chris, and Dan have seen it and said it was ok to post it here. 

I'm asking for feedback on everything (colors, organization, etc.) but mostly on how well I explained the functions, and if they are clear enough, or if there is something I should have included that I didn't, or should remove because it's too confusing. Leave your comments here on this post so we can all see them. 

Thank you in advance!
